what: GNN depth sweep on Task 2 (GraphSAGE, segment graphs), test split.
why: Checking whether the saturated graph-coherence score (S_graph ~= 0.999) indicated depth-driven oversmoothing. It did not: deeper is slightly better, and S_graph is ~0.999 at every depth. S_graph saturates because post-ReLU node features are non-negative, so cosine similarity is high for edges and non-edges alike. The informative quantity is the lift of edge similarity over non-edge similarity (see gnn_model.graph_coherence_score).
setup: 20 epochs, batch 16, identical config otherwise; one run per depth.
conclusion: Depth 3-4 is the plateau; 1 layer clearly underfits. No evidence of oversmoothing damage in this range. Default stays at 3.
